conference.title: 12th SCAR Open Science Conference (SCAR 2026 Oslo)
conference.location: Oslo, Norway (Clarion The Hub / Domus Academica / Professorboligen)

business_verticals.name: Logística Marítima y Predicción de Hielo
business_verticals.description: Predicción de hielos costeros (landfast ice), polinias, dinámicas de deshielo y corrientes para optimización de rutas, reducción de consumo de búnker y seguridad náutica.

business_verticals.name: Robótica, Drones (RPAS) y Sensores Autónomos
business_verticals.description: Cumplimiento normativo para RPAS sobre fauna silvestre, inspección con vehículos autónomos submarinos (AUVs/gliders) y estaciones remotas con IA.

business_verticals.name: Ecoturismo Polar, RegTech y Gateway Cities
business_verticals.description: Capacidad de carga turística (+100.000 pax/año), autorizaciones, citizen science monetizable a bordo y gestión logística en ciudades puerta (Ushuaia, Punta Arenas).

business_verticals.name: Bioeconomía y Bioprospección de Extremófilos
business_verticals.description: Metabolómica, enzimas frías para la industria química/farmacéutica, proteínas anticongelantes y monitoreo molecular de biomasa de krill y peces polares.

business_verticals.name: Descarbonización y Tecnologías Verdes
business_verticals.description: Microrredes de energía renovable para bases extremas, combustibles marinos limpios, contabilidad y auditoría de huella de carbono en la Antártida.

business_verticals.name: Inteligencia Geoespacial, AI & Quantarctica v4
business_verticals.description: Más de 600 capas geoespaciales libres, datos radargráficos, gemelos digitales de mantos de hielo y algoritmos de machine learning listos para comercializar.

sessions.title: Joint AMAP-AnMAP Workshop on Priority Setting of Chemical Monitoring Needs in Antarctica for IPY5
sessions.description: Harmonized chemical monitoring networks in Antarctica have been identified as a key capacity gap ahead of IPY5. Aligns Antarctic efforts with Arctic 30+ year monitoring best practices. Produces roadmap of priority monitoring agendas, resource mobilisation pathways, and implementation networks.

business_impact.opportunity: Desarrollo y venta de kits de sensores químicos in-situ de alta precisión certificados para estándares polares internacionales (AMAP/AnMAP).

sessions.title: Paleoclimate Records from the Antarctic Margin and Southern Ocean (PRAMSO)
sessions.description: Coordinating scientific drilling across the Antarctic margin and Southern Ocean, including key land-to-sea transects to obtain direct records of past ice sheet dynamics and ice-ocean interactions.

business_impact.opportunity: Servicios de soporte logístico y charter de buques de perforación científica con capacidad de aguas profundas y posicionamiento dinámico.

sessions.title: Antarctic Arts – towards IPY-5 2032/3
sessions.description: Promotes transdisciplinary arts and culture programs for the 5th International Polar Year, addressing public engagement, cultural residencies, and science-art fusion.

business_impact.opportunity: Residencias artísticas y contenidos multimedia de inmersión para buques de expedición turística y centros interpretativos en ciudades puerta.

sessions.title: Changes in Circumpolar Antarctic Gradients in Ecosystems (C-CAGE)
sessions.description: Using natural environmental gradients in temperature, ice cover, and other physical drivers across latitude, longitude, altitude and depth to predict future ecological changes and biodiversity shifts.

business_impact.opportunity: Mapeo predictivo de zonas biológicas críticas para mitigación de impacto ambiental y planificación de zonas de conservación comercial (MPAs).

sessions.title: Antarctica InSync Theme V: Anthropogenic Signatures in Antarctica – The Race Against Pollution and Other Pressures
sessions.description: Focuses on anthropogenic signatures: chemical contaminants, microplastics, underwater acoustic noise from shipping, non-native species risks, and station infrastructure footprints.

business_impact.opportunity: Auditorías de huella acústica y microplásticos para buques de crucero y estaciones polares; certificación de sello verde marítimo polar.

sessions.title: Censusing Animal Populations From Space (CAPS)
sessions.description: SOOS CAPS group meeting on satellite observation of polar vertebrate species (penguins, seals, whales) via high-resolution optical and SAR imagery, automated counting with machine learning.

business_impact.opportunity: Comercialización de algoritmos de detección por satélite para monitoreo automatizado de fauna sin incurrir en misiones aéreas costosas.

sessions.title: SCAR's Standing Committee on Antarctic Data Management (SCADM)
sessions.description: Coordinates Antarctic data management systems, FAIR principles compliance, and data exchange frameworks between national Antarctic operators.

business_impact.opportunity: Conectividad nativa de AMOH con repositorios oficiales SCADM, posicionando la app como interfaz de acceso rápido de referencia para buques.

sessions.title: SCAR Groundwater Action Group
sessions.description: Explores the hidden role of subglacial groundwater in ice-sheet dynamics, sub-ice drainage, environmental and biological processes.

business_impact.opportunity: Modelos hidrológicos subglaciares para evaluar zonas de riesgo de colapso de glaciares terminales.

sessions.title: Co-creating a framework for a Weddell Sea Observatory of Biodiversity and ecosystem change (WOBEC) (Block I)
sessions.description: Co-creation of a long-term ecosystem observatory in the Eastern Weddell Sea / King Haakon VII Sea with industry, policy, and NGOs. Presents results from recent 2025/2026 expedition and blueprints for international engagement.

business_impact.opportunity: Provisión de equipamiento de boyas oceanográficas autónomas, transmisiones telemétricas satelitales y contratos de soporte a largo plazo.

sessions.title: SCAR Expert Group on Birds and Marine Mammals (EG-BAMM)
sessions.description: Multidisciplinary synthesis of biophysical and biochemical coupling mechanisms of birds and mammals, population trends, and status for conservation and management under ATS.

business_impact.opportunity: Datos clave de corredores biológicos para evitar colisiones entre buques y cetáceos (Whale strike avoidance).

sessions.title: Instabilities & Thresholds in Antarctica (INSTANT) Workshop
sessions.description: Addresses first-order questions about Antarctica's contribution to global sea level rise, ocean-atmosphere-cryosphere interactions, and geo-engineering mitigation options.

business_impact.opportunity: Servicios de asesoría y modelado de riesgo de subida del nivel del mar para infraestructura portuaria global y compañías aseguradoras marítimas.

sessions.title: Products available on cloud at Google Earth Engine to study the Antarctic Ice Sheet
sessions.description: Workshop on solutions for orbital imagery in Antarctica (radar, optical, embeddings), image processing algorithms, date filtering, and metadata in Google Earth Engine.

business_impact.opportunity: Integración directa de pipelines de GEE en el backend de AMOH para renderizar mosaicos SAR y ópticos casi en tiempo real a costo marginal.

sessions.title: Human Research Biomedical experiments at Concordia Station
sessions.description: Concordia Station (3200m altitude, French-Italian, ESA partnership) as Earth-based analogue for long-duration deep space missions. Chronic hypobaric hypoxia, crew psychology, telemedicine, and health performance in extreme isolation.

business_impact.opportunity: Soluciones de telemedicina satelital de emergencia y biomarcadores de estrés para tripulaciones marítimas en viajes de larga distancia y astronautas.

sessions.title: West Antarctic Peninsula and Scotia Arc workshop (SOOS-WAPSA)
sessions.description: Focuses on oceanographic and ecological evidence across the Antarctic Peninsula and Scotia Arc, setting priorities for marine observing systems and SOOS Science Plan 2026.

business_impact.opportunity: La Península Antártica concentra el 95% del tráfico de cruceros y pesquerías; datos críticos para optimizar corredores náuticos del Paso Drake.

sessions.title: SCAR Antarctic Digital Magnetic Anomaly Project (ADMAP)
sessions.description: Compiling and integrating near-surface and satellite magnetic anomaly data into a digital database to decipher Gondwana and Rodinia tectonic evolution.

business_impact.opportunity: Calibración de sistemas de navegación inercial y magnética de respaldo para buques y drones polares donde el GPS sufre interferencias geomagnéticas.

sessions.title: Past, present, and future of the Wilkes Subglacial Basin
sessions.description: Examines East Antarctic Ice Sheet marine-based Wilkes Subglacial Basin holding 3-4m equivalent global sea-level rise. Fieldwork plans for multi-national ice and ocean programs.

business_impact.opportunity: Contratos de logística polar pesada para campañas multinacionales en la Antártida Oriental.

sessions.title: RINGS + Joint RINGS-IBCSO meeting (Seaward Ring & Bathymetry)
sessions.description: Focuses on the seaward ring linking subglacial and marine domains, seabed beneath ice shelves, and bathymetry across ice shelf grounding promontories and continental shelves.

business_impact.opportunity: Las cartas batimétricas de alta resolución de IBCSO son el recurso más demandado por armadores de buques polares para prevenir encallamientos en aguas no cartografiadas.

sessions.title: Cross-disciplinary research for understanding and communicating near-term climate impacts (AntClimNow)
sessions.description: Brings together multi-disciplinary researchers to analyze near-term (1-30 years) climate impacts around Antarctica, forecasting regional changes and societal consequences.

business_impact.opportunity: Informes de inteligencia de riesgo climático a 1-5 años para operadores de puertos australes y flotas pesqueras.

sessions.title: Sub-Antarctic Island Ecosystems: Connecting Physical, Biological and Biogeochemical Processes
sessions.description: Investigating sub-Antarctic islands as biodiversity hotspots and stepping stones in the Antarctic Circumpolar Current. Discusses BOUVECO (Bouvetøya) and K-POD (South Orkney Islands krill-predator dynamics) projects.

business_impact.opportunity: Modelado de biomasa para la gestión pesquera sustentable de krill e identificación de zonas de exclusión biológica.

sessions.title: Plastic in Polar Environments (SPEG) Expert Group
sessions.description: Examines presence, origin, and biological effects of macro-, micro-, and nanoplastics in polar ecosystems; proposes regulatory and technical mitigation solutions.

business_impact.opportunity: Sistemas de filtrado de aguas grises y microplásticos certificados para buques clase polar bajo Código Polar de la OMI.

sessions.title: Joint meeting of EG Geodetic Infrastructure in Antarctica (GIANT) and INSTANT SC2.2
sessions.description: Geodetic GNSS networks, seismology, tide gauges, airborne gravimetry, magnetotellurics, and Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) to probe the solid Earth and its ice interaction.

business_impact.opportunity: Suministro e instalación de estaciones GNSS autónomas de ultra bajo consumo y cables de fibra óptica sensorizados (DAS) para monitoreo portuario.

sessions.title: Antarctic Geospace and Atmosphere Research (AGATA)
sessions.description: Polar atmosphere and near-Earth space environment, space weather impacts on satellite links and navigation, ionospheric scintillation, and auroral electrodynamics.

business_impact.opportunity: Pronóstico de cortes de comunicaciones satelitales (Starlink, Iridium) provocados por tormentas solares en altas latitudes, indispensable para operaciones marítimas.

sessions.title: Sea Ice Processes & Climate (ASPeCt)
sessions.description: Improving knowledge of the Antarctic sea-ice zone through sustained field observations, satellite remote sensing, ship-based standardized underway observations, and numerical models.

business_impact.opportunity: Estandarización de software de a bordo para registro automatizado de hielos por cámaras de visión artificial en puentes de mando.

sessions.title: Antarctic Wildlife Health Network (AWHN) & HPAI Outbreak Database
sessions.description: Expert advice on novel and emerging disease threats to Antarctic wildlife. Central database for pathogens and disease outbreaks (expansion of SCAR HPAI - High Pathogenicity Avian Influenza database) and mortality events.

business_impact.opportunity: Protocolos y software de bioseguridad para operadores turísticos: desinfección de calzado, detección rápida de brotes para desvío de desembarcos.

sessions.title: Joint SCAR/COMNAP/NPI Symposium: Investing in Observational Infrastructure and Expertise for IPY-5 and Beyond
sessions.description: High-level strategic symposium featuring COMNAP Chair, SCAR President, and national delegates. Addresses funding, autonomous observation platforms, data sharing, and public-private partnerships for IPY-5 (2032-33).

business_impact.opportunity: Acceso a licitaciones internacionales multimillonarias para modernización de infraestructura y buques polares de investigación.

sessions.title: S3 – Polar Meteorology and Atmospheric Processes: Weather, Water Cycle, Snow, Clouds, Radiation, Gravity Waves
sessions.description: Covers numerical weather prediction in polar regions, katabatic winds, cloud microphysics, water isotopes, aerosols, Southern Ocean radiation bias, and extreme storm cycles.

business_impact.opportunity: Modelos meteorológicos hiperlocales para evitar vientos catabáticos destructivos en fondeaderos de buques y helipuertos de bases antárticas.

sessions.title: S12 – Reconstructing past Antarctic ice-sheet dynamics to inform future projections
sessions.description: Quantifying previous ice sheet collapse rates to calibrate modern models; examines 57m sea-level equivalent ice masses, marine-based records, and deglaciation thresholds.

business_impact.opportunity: Datos de referencia para cálculo actuarial de primas de riesgo de infraestructuras costeras mundiales.

sessions.title: S32 – Antarctic Tourism: Aiming for a Sustainable Future
sessions.description: Addresses the boom of Antarctic tourism (>100,000 visitors), cumulative site impacts, permitting regimes, safety and risk management, citizen science, and governance futures.

business_impact.opportunity: Desarrollo de software de reserva y asignación de sitios de desembarco en tiempo real para evitar congestión de buques y cumplir límites de IAATO/ATCM.

sessions.title: S31 – Health and Diseases of Antarctic Wildlife
sessions.description: Surveillance of infectious pathogens, toxicology, and environmental stressors impacting penguins, marine mammals, fish, and birds across Antarctica and sub-Antarctic islands.

business_impact.opportunity: Kits de diagnóstico PCR portátil para tripulaciones de buques de expedición para verificar bioseguridad antes de desembarcos.

sessions.title: S42 – Plastic Pollution in Antarctica and the Southern Ocean: Sources, Pathways, Impacts, and Governance
sessions.description: Macro-, micro-, and nanoplastics in seawater, snow, sea ice, and organisms. Interacts with persistent organic pollutants (POPs) and limits of current Antarctic Treaty System management tools.

business_impact.opportunity: Fabricación de empaques biodegradables ultrarresistentes a temperaturas bajo cero y tecnologías de despolimerización de plásticos in-situ.

sessions.title: S39 – Coordinated Long-Term Observations in Antarctica: Building the Network of Networks
sessions.description: Focuses on multinational marine and terrestrial observing networks, interoperability, data sharing standards, and scaling local observations to pan-Antarctic coverage.

business_impact.opportunity: Consolidación de AMOH como el agregador neutral de datos abiertos para la iniciativa 'Network of Networks'.

sessions.title: S26 – Terrestrial and Marine Bioinvasions in Antarctica and the Southern Ocean
sessions.description: Biological invasions (Trichocera maculipennis, Eretmoptera murphyi, Poa annua, marine fouling), introduction pathways, ship hull biofouling, and rapid response eradication protocols.

business_impact.opportunity: Servicios de limpieza e inspección de cascos de barcos con ROVs submarinos y robots magnéticos antes de entrar al Tratado Antártico.

sessions.title: S8 – Antarctic Extreme Events – Causes and Feedbacks
sessions.description: Atmospheric rivers, extreme snowfall, heatwaves, abrupt sea ice collapse, meltwater ponding, and hydrofracture destabilizing ice shelves.

business_impact.opportunity: Sistemas de alerta temprana de ríos atmosféricos (Atmospheric Rivers) para alertas de evacuación marítima en bases y fondeaderos.

sessions.title: W9 – Southern Ocean Air-sea Flux Measurements (SOCAT & SOFLUX)
sessions.description: Air-sea heat and carbon fluxes, uncrewed surface vehicles (USVs / Saildrones), surface ocean CO2 Atlas (SOCAT), SOCONET, and UN Ocean Decade Antarctica InSync coordination.

business_impact.opportunity: Despliegue comercial de drones de superficie no tripulados (USVs tipo Saildrone) para monitoreo oceánico continuo contratado por gobiernos.

sessions.title: W21 – Tourism as a Facilitator of Antarctic Research: Practical Lessons
sessions.description: Brings together polar researchers and tour operators (IAATO) to evaluate vessels of opportunity, co-funding, field berths for scientists, and data-sharing agreements.

business_impact.opportunity: Plataforma de marketplace B2B para que cruceros vendan camarotes desocupados o espacio de laboratorio a científicos a tarifas de flete compartidas.

sessions.title: W11 – Best Practice for RPAS (Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems / Drones) use around Wildlife in Antarctica
sessions.description: Guidelines for drone operators over sensitive wildlife (penguins, seals, seabirds). Addresses distance thresholds, acoustic disturbance, flight envelopes, and ATCM compliance.

business_impact.opportunity: Certificación de pilotos y geofencing automatizado en software de vuelo de drones para garantizar distancias mínimas legales sobre colonias de pingüinos.

sessions.title: S28 – Genomic Insights into Past, Present and Future Antarctic Biodiversity
sessions.description: Genomics-based ecological advances in extreme cold adaptations, demographic history, diversification of microorganisms, invertebrates, and fishes under climate stress.

business_impact.opportunity: Descubrimiento de genes de resistencia térmica y antioxidantes para aplicaciones en biotecnología agrícola y conservación criogénica de tejidos.

sessions.title: S47 – Antarctica InSync: From Synchronous Observations to Policy and Governance for a Changing Antarctic
sessions.description: Translates synchronous observations across oceanography, glaciology, and biology into actionable policy for UNCLOS and the Antarctic Treaty System. Tackles climate litigation and intervention measures.

business_impact.opportunity: Asesoría legal estratégica a armadores y operadores frente a futuras moratorias y cuotas de navegación en áreas marinas protegidas.

sessions.title: W15 – Multidisciplinary Southern Ocean Methane Research
sessions.description: Investigates marine methane seeps in the Southern Ocean, benthic methane oxidizers, and climate-induced permafrost/methane release feedbacks.

business_impact.opportunity: Sensores submarinos acústicos y químicos para detección de fugas de metano y cuantificación de créditos de carbono azul.

sessions.title: Plenary: Parameterising melt at the base of Antarctic ice shelves – is deep learning the miracle solution?
convenors: Dr. Clara Burgard (LOCEAN / IPSL / CNRS, France)
sessions.description: Deep learning parameterizations for ocean-induced basal melting of ice shelves, replacing computationally prohibitive cavity-resolving 3D ocean circulation models for long-term sea level projections.

business_impact.opportunity: Modelos sustitutos (AI Surrogate Models) ultra-rápidos que corren en edge/laptops en segundos en lugar de supercomputadoras, ideales para el motor de simulación de AMOH.

sessions.title: Mini-Symposium: Terrestrial Invasions in Antarctica: Emerging Threats, Adaptive Mechanisms, and Governance Challenges
sessions.description: Over 100 recorded establishment events of invasive species (Trichocera maculipennis, Eretmoptera murphyi, Poa annua). Evaluates feasibility of a new SCAR Action Group on terrestrial invasions and on-the-ground management gaps.

business_impact.opportunity: Sistemas de bioseguridad no invasivos (cámaras de desinfección UV-C y aspirado HEPA de ropa técnica de expedición) para estaciones y cruceros.

sessions.title: S13 – Past, present, and future of Antarctic marine grounded basins
sessions.description: Marine-based sectors of West and East Antarctica (Amundsen Sea Embayment, Thwaites, Pine Island, Wilkes) prone to Marine Ice Sheet Instability (MISI) and Marine Ice Cliff Instability (MICI).

business_impact.opportunity: Monitoreo satelital focalizado sobre desprendimiento de megabergas para alertas de navegación en el Mar de Bellingshausen y Amundsen.

sessions.title: S29 – Southern Ocean Biogeochemistry: Linking ecosystem dynamics, nutrient cycling, and carbon export
sessions.description: Block 1 (Iron and phytoplankton), Block 2 (CO2 and sea ice), Block 3 (Benthos, export and CH4). Focuses on ocean acidification, biological carbon pump, and micronutrient fertilization.

business_impact.opportunity: Medición y verificación de proyectos de secuestro de carbono oceánico (mCDR - Marine Carbon Dioxide Removal).

sessions.title: S6 – Understanding Rapid Changes in the Atmosphere–Ice–Ocean Boundary of the Southern Ocean
sessions.description: Energy fluxes beneath and above sea ice and ice shelves, marginal ice zone (MIZ) dynamics, landfast ice collapse, and rapid sea-ice decline drivers.

business_impact.opportunity: Servicios de predicción de la Zona de Hielo Marginal (MIZ) para evitar que buques no rompehielos queden atrapados por compresión de pack ice.

sessions.title: S18 – Southern Ocean top predator dynamics: ecological changes and implications for marine mammals
sessions.description: Block 1 (Pinnipeds - seals), Block 2 (Cetaceans - whales and top predators). Population genetics, telemetry tracking, foraging hotspots, and trophic interactions.

business_impact.opportunity: Rutas de avistamiento responsable de fauna para turismo de expedición basadas en hotspots de alimentación en tiempo real.

sessions.title: S43 – Chemical Contamination in Antarctica: From Global Transport to Local Remediation
sessions.description: Legacy pollutants (POPs, heavy metals) and emerging chemicals (PFAS forever chemicals, pharmaceuticals, microplastics) around station wastewater, legacy dumps, and fuel spills. Remediation and soil restoration methods.

business_impact.opportunity: Servicios de biorremediación de derrames de hidrocarburos con bacterias polarizadas y sistemas de tratamiento de aguas residuales para bases científicas.

sessions.title: S48 – Pathways to polar decarbonization: How can Antarctic research operations lead the way?
sessions.description: Scalable technologies to decarbonize polar science: renewable microgrids (wind/solar/batteries), hydrogen/ammonia logistics, low-emission shipping, and carbon accounting standards across COMNAP/SCAR.

business_impact.opportunity: Integración de microrredes híbridas y auditoría de huella de carbono para operadores de flotas marítimas y bases polares.

sessions.title: W13 – SCARFISH and SKEG: Joint Action on Antarctic Fish and Krill Fisheries
sessions.description: Explores overlap between krill biology and fish ecology under CCAMLR. Focuses on fishery quotas, ecosystem feedbacks, and data sharing between industry and scientists.

business_impact.opportunity: La pesquería de krill mueve más de $500M anuales; software de monitoreo de capturas y cumplimiento de cuotas CCAMLR en tiempo real.

sessions.title: S22 – Terrestrial Antarctic Communities: Mapping and monitoring Antarctic vegetation greening under climate change
sessions.description: Antarctic greening detection challenges using UAV/drones, satellite imagery, AI and machine learning, overcoming false NDVI readings from mixed cryptogam pixels (mosses, lichens, algae).

business_impact.opportunity: Software de fotogrametría hiperespectral y clasificación por IA adaptado a especies criptógamas para prospección remota.

sessions.title: W2 – Connecting Earth Observations and Antarctica InSync expeditions (Pulse of the Weddell)
sessions.description: Satellite Earth Observation (ESA Polar Science Cluster, Digital Earth Antarctica, Digital Twin Ice Sheets) supporting planned 2027-28 expeditions like 'Pulse of the Weddell' (POW).

business_impact.opportunity: Integración con el Gemelo Digital Antártico (Digital Twin) de la ESA para simulación predictiva de navegación en hielos.

sessions.title: Poster Session I & Digital Posters Showcase
sessions.description: Exhibition of physical posters and digital interactive posters covering all S1-S20 sessions, early career innovations, sensor prototypes, and field trial results.

business_impact.opportunity: Scouting de patentes emergentes y contacto directo con jóvenes investigadores (ECRs) para reclutamiento de talento de I+D.

sessions.title: Towards effective management of Antarctic Tourism: a science and policy perspective
sessions.description: Lightning talks on translating cutting-edge science into ready-to-use policy recommendations for ATCM and CEP on Antarctic tourism expansion, landing caps, and environmental impact mitigation.

business_impact.opportunity: Anticiparse a las nuevas restricciones regulatorias del Tratado Antártico (ATCM) para diseñar productos turísticos premium con licencia anticipada.

sessions.title: National Geographic and Rolex Perpetual Planet Southern Ocean Expedition: Showcase and Party for Krill
sessions.description: World Krill Day celebration sharing discoveries from the 3-week expedition aboard Schmidt Ocean Institute's R/V Falkor (too), linking deep-sea imagery to krill conservation solutions.

business_impact.opportunity: Sinergia de patrocinio corporativo de alto nivel (Rolex / NatGeo); benchmark de alianzas para financiar expediciones en buques AMOH.

sessions.title: Plenary: Six Decades of Antarctic Tourism: Evolution, Governance, and Emerging Challenges
convenors: Prof. Marisol Vereda (IDEI, Universidad Nacional de Tierra del Fuego, Ushuaia, Argentina)
sessions.description: Historical transformation of tourism into a central dimension of Antarctic human mobility. Analyzes gateway cities (Ushuaia, Punta Arenas, Hobart) as strategic logistical nodes, regulatory frameworks, vessel technology trends, and futures.

business_impact.opportunity: Desarrollo de servicios de aprovisionamiento, combustible bajo en carbono y logística portuaria especializada en Ushuaia y Punta Arenas.

sessions.title: Data Infrastructure and Machine Learning for Polar Geospace Research Workshop
sessions.description: Standardized metadata catalogs for Antarctic and Arctic geospace instruments and applying Machine Learning (ML) techniques for space weather forecasting, dealing with data heterogeneity and high-latitude anomalies.

business_impact.opportunity: Modelos predictivos de perturbaciones electromagnéticas para proteger satélites comerciales LEO y sistemas de posicionamiento GPS/Galileo.

sessions.title: S27 – Polar Microbiomes in a Changing Planet
sessions.description: Block 1 (Soil communities / Health interface), Block 2 (Ice-Snow-Water communities), Block 3 (Symbiotic communities). Functional roles in carbon capture, organic matter cycling, and biotechnological applications.

business_impact.opportunity: Bioprospección de bacterias psicrófilas (adaptadas al frío) para la producción de enzimas industriales que operan a baja temperatura ahorrando energía en lavados industriales y síntesis farmacéutica.

sessions.title: S11 – Imaging and Monitoring Antarctica’s Cryosphere: Geophysical Methods and Applications
sessions.modality: Oral Presentations (Blocks I, II, III, IV)
sessions.description: Radar (GPR, ApRES), active/passive seismics, airborne and drone platforms, marine AUVs/gliders, DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensing) for basal ice characterization and grounding line stability.

business_impact.opportunity: Sensores de radar ApRES autónomos conectados a satélite para monitorizar en tiempo real el adelgazamiento de plataformas de hielo que amenazan rutas marítimas.

sessions.title: S34 – Antarctic Governance at the International and Domestic Level
sessions.description: Examines legal regimes under the Antarctic Treaty System (ATS), CCAMLR, Marine Protected Areas (MPAs), bioprospecting rights, and domestic legislation across Antarctic nations.

business_impact.opportunity: Seguridad jurídica para patentes comerciales derivadas de bioprospección antártica asegurando total cumplimiento con el Protocolo de Madrid.

sessions.title: S20 – Advances in Southern Ocean fish ecology: patterns, processes, and management implications
sessions.description: Fish biomass dynamics, commercial fisheries (Patagonian & Antarctic Toothfish / Bacalao de profundidad), genomics, physiology, and resilience under shifting ocean temperatures.

business_impact.opportunity: Trazabilidad digital y certificación blockchain contra la pesca ilegal, no declarada y no reglamentada (INDNR / IUU fishing) de merluza negra.

sessions.title: S38 – Emerging Frontiers in Antarctic Observation Science (Robotics, AI & Autonomous Platforms)
sessions.description: Earth Observation, autonomous platforms (gliders AUV/ROV, deep-ocean rovers, AWS, robotic cameras), cold-region engineering, alternative energy, and physics-informed AI / Machine Learning predictive models.

business_impact.opportunity: Núcleo tecnológico directo para AMOH: integración de flotas de drones y planeadores submarinos operando en enjambre con algoritmos de IA predictiva.

sessions.title: W18 – Impactful Conservation Research for the Committee for Environmental Protection (Elevator Pitches)
sessions.description: Quick-fire elevator pitches to CEP (Committee for Environmental Protection) representatives, turning academic research into immediate policy options and management tools.

business_impact.opportunity: Metodología ágil de 'elevator pitch' para presentar soluciones tecnológicas de AMOH ante delegados gubernamentales y comités del Tratado.

sessions.title: W14 – Terrestrial Snow and Ice Algae – Field Sampling and Lab Experiments
sessions.description: Snow algae blooms in Antarctica, sampling protocols, cell density, culturing techniques, biomass analysis, and drone/satellite remote sensing of bloom events.

business_impact.opportunity: Las microalgas de nieve producen astaxantina y carotenoides de alta pureza con demanda en la industria nutracéutica y cosmética anti-edad.

sessions.title: Poster Session II & Digital Posters Showcase
sessions.description: Covers geosciences, climate models, remote sensing algorithms, bioprospecting findings, and polar medicine clinical case studies.

business_impact.opportunity: Revisión rápida de cientos de soluciones técnicas no publicadas formalmente en journals para adopción temprana en AMOH.

sessions.title: 20 Years of the Antarctic Biodiversity Portal (biodiversity.aq) and the Road Ahead
sessions.description: Celebrates 20 years of biodiversity.aq (SCAR MarBIN), linking Antarctic biological data with OBIS, GBIF, and FAIR digital ecosystems.

business_impact.opportunity: Integración de las APIs de biodiversity.aq y OBIS en el catálogo de capas biológicas de AMOH.

sessions.title: Plenary: The Deep Geological Structure of Antarctica and Implications for Ice Sheet Dynamics
convenors: Prof. Douglas A. Wiens (Washington University in St Louis, USA)
sessions.description: Deep geological structure from seismographs deployed across Antarctica, cratonic lithosphere vs thin warm mantle beneath West Antarctica, geothermal heat flux, and rapid Glacial Isostatic Adjustment (GIA) slowing or accelerating collapse.

business_impact.opportunity: Información clave sobre flujos térmicos geotérmicos y batimetría profunda para navegación de sumergibles.

sessions.title: Mini-Symposium: From Science-to-Policy: Climate-smart Marine Spatial Planning (MSP) in the Southern Ocean
sessions.description: Presents climate-smart Marine Spatial Planning (MSP) with stakeholders including SCAR, CCAMLR, COMNAP, IAATO, and ASOC to balance conservation, fisheries, tourism, and science.

business_impact.opportunity: Software de zonificación marina dinámica: visualización de áreas protegidas y zonas de veda pesquera en tiempo real en los radares de AMOH.

sessions.title: S7 – From Shelf to Deep Basin: Southern Ocean Circulation and Exchanges
sessions.description: Circumpolar Deep Water (CDW) intrusion onto shelves, Antarctic Bottom Water (AABW) and Dense Shelf Water (DSW) production, cross-shelf exchanges, and mooring arrays.

business_impact.opportunity: Optimización del rumbo naval basada en corrientes de profundidad y afloramientos de aguas cálidas para ahorro de combustible en tránsito transpolar.

sessions.title: S19 – Polar plankton: Diversity, patterns, processes, and trends
sessions.description: Phytoplankton, krill, and meroplankton as ecosystem indicators. Technologies: eDNA (environmental DNA), optical in-situ imaging, autonomous samplers, and biogeochemical models.

business_impact.opportunity: Sensores eDNA de flujo continuo instalados en tomas de agua de buques comerciales para monitoreo continuo de biodiversidad como servicio B2B.

sessions.title: S51 – Human Biology and Medicine in Extreme Polar Environments
sessions.description: Medical care in extreme isolation, severe cold, prolonged daylight/darkness, psychiatric screening, emergency MEDEVAC, telemedicine, dental emergencies, and space analogue studies.

business_impact.opportunity: Servicio de cobertura médica satelital 24/7 y triage de evacuaciones médicas (MEDEVAC) para cruceros privados en la Antártida.

sessions.title: S37 – Understanding Antarctic Sea Ice: Earth-system Interactions, Change, and Global Significance
sessions.description: Block 1 (drivers, responses, prediction), Block 2 (observations, processes, connections). Landfast sea ice variability, thickness measurements, snow cover on ice, and climate feedbacks.

business_impact.opportunity: Suscripción de inteligencia de hielo marino de alta resolución (grosor de hielo y deformación) para capitanes de buques de pasaje y carga.

sessions.title: Poster Session III & Digital Posters Showcase
sessions.description: Third major poster session presenting marine mammal telemetry, sub-Antarctic island peatland dynamics, atmospheric chemistry, and emerging sensor hardware.

business_impact.opportunity: Identificación de proveedores de hardware y sensores de grado marino listos para ser montados en buques asociados a AMOH.

sessions.title: Plenary: Genes, Islands, and Surprises: Two Decades of Research in the Southern Ocean, Sub-Antarctic Islands, and Antarctica
convenors: Prof. Bettine van Vuuren (University of Johannesburg, South Africa)
sessions.description: Spatial genetic patterns, population structure, connectivity, and evolutionary history across the Southern Ocean and sub-Antarctic islands. Discusses new genomic technologies and institutional governance.

business_impact.opportunity: Desarrollo de biomarcadores genómicos para certificar el origen geográfico de productos marinos polares de alto valor comercial.

sessions.title: S16 – Remote Sensing Advances in Observing, Monitoring, and Mapping the Antarctic
sessions.description: Multi-sensor satellite approaches (Sentinel, ICESat-2, CryoSat), drones, AI/automated mapping of ice velocity, mass balance, snow/sea ice, grounding line retreat, and open geospatial data pipelines.

business_impact.opportunity: Alimentación del radar satelital de AMOH con feeds procesados de radar SAR para detección instantánea de grietas en plataformas de hielo.

sessions.title: W17 – Plastics in the Polar Regions: Building an International Research Campaign for IPY5
sessions.description: Standardized plastic monitoring and sampling, data evaluation, plastic impact assessment, and science-policy white paper development for IPY5.

business_impact.opportunity: Comercialización de equipos de muestreo de microplásticos estandarizados para buques oceanográficos y yates privados.

sessions.title: S10 – Antarctic Ice Sheet and Southern Ocean Dynamics: Coupled System Responses to Climate Change and Sea-Level Implications
sessions.description: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for ice sheet modeling, satellite techniques using deep learning for grounding line monitoring, and reversal of deep ocean circulation bringing trapped heat to surface.

business_impact.opportunity: Implementación de redes neuronales informadas por la física (PINNs) para pronósticos de descongelamiento en la plataforma AMOH.

sessions.title: O4 – Quantarctica v4 Launch & Community Showcase: A New Era for Antarctic GIS
sessions.description: Official launch of Quantarctica Version 4: over 600 curated GIS layers (double version 3.2), unified ready-to-use framework for research, field operations, voyage planning, and education on QGIS.

business_impact.opportunity: Integración de las 600 capas de Quantarctica v4 en MapLibre de AMOH: batimetría, topografía subglaciar y estaciones sin pagar licencias de ESRI.

sessions.title: O7 – How to Implement a Molecular Monitoring of Microbial Diversity
sessions.description: Strategy for molecular sequence-based monitoring of microorganisms (bacteria, cyanobacteria, micro-fungi) in non-geothermal ice-free areas where microbes form almost the entire ecosystem.

business_impact.opportunity: Desarrollo de chips de secuenciación de nanoporos (Oxford Nanopore) para biovigilancia ambiental automática in-situ.

sessions.title: S1 – Safeguarding Antarctica’s Dark and Quiet Skies: Astronomy, Astrophysics, and Outer Space Collaboration
sessions.description: Antarctica as clean observatory for cosmic microwave background, particle physics, and space weather forecasting. Addresses satellite constellation interference (Starlink/Kuiper), orbital debris reentries, and cross-regime governance with the Outer Space Treaty.

business_impact.opportunity: Monitoreo y predicción de trayectorias de reentrada de chatarra espacial sobre el Océano Austral para avisos a navegantes (NOTAM/NAVAREA).

sessions.title: W16 – Ross Sea Region Marine Protected Area Research Coordination Network (Silverfish Consortium)
sessions.description: Preparation for the 10-year review of the Ross Sea MPA by CCAMLR in 2027. Presents the Silverfish international funding and coordination consortium, biophysical modeling, and cyberinfrastructure.

business_impact.opportunity: Proveer la infraestructura de ciberdatos y panel analítico para la revisión decenal de la mayor Área Marina Protegida del planeta en 2027.

sessions.title: W25 – Predator REsponses to seasonal krill DYnamiC and krill fishing activities (PREDYCT)
sessions.description: Assessing spatiotemporal overlap between industrial krill fisheries and predators (penguins, seals, whales) in the Antarctic Peninsula. Multi-platform protocols combining predator tagging, acoustic krill surveys, and fishing vessel telemetry.

business_impact.opportunity: Desarrollo de algoritmos de optimización de capturas para la flota pesquera que garanticen no interferir con colonias de cría, evitando sanciones internacionales.

sessions.title: W6 – Integrated Observing Networks for Future Earth (SOOS, ARGO, AI)
sessions.description: Integrating data across disciplinary silos: lessons from SOOS, ARGO floats, Long-Term Ecological Research (LTER), and using AI for data synthesis across autonomous platforms.

business_impact.opportunity: Ingesta directa de los ~4000 flotadores ARGO polares en tiempo real dentro del motor de corrientes y temperatura de AMOH.

sessions.title: Towards a synchronized circumpolar Southern Ocean observing system – SYNCHRONY workshop
sessions.description: New EU-funded project advancing synchronized circumpolar observation systems across physical, chemical, biological, and societal data, integrating industry and policymakers towards IPY-5.

business_impact.opportunity: Oportunidades de financiación Horizon Europe para consorcios público-privados de monitoreo marítimo polar.

sessions.title: Future of Antarctic Marine Ecosystems Explorer – an interactive atlas for Southern Ocean Marine Ecosystem Model Ensemble (SOMEME)
sessions.description: Interactive atlas visualizing multi-model ensemble ecosystem projections under alternative climate scenarios, disaggregated by CCAMLR management areas under the UN Ocean Decade FishMIP.

business_impact.opportunity: Módulo de proyecciones ecológicas interactivo listo para embeber como micro-frontend en el explorador de AMOH.

sessions.title: Antarctic Extremes across disciplines: building understanding and community (ATCM49 Information Paper)
sessions.description: Compiling an impactful summary of extreme weather and environmental anomalies, drafting an Information Paper for the Antarctic Treaty Consultative Meeting 49 (ATCM49 in 2027).

business_impact.opportunity: Posicionar a AMOH como fuente de datos citada en los papeles informativos oficiales del Tratado Antártico.

sessions.title: Raised2.0 – A new geological reconstruction of Antarctic Ice Sheet deglaciation since the LGM
sessions.description: Introduces relational databases for dynamic collation of geochronological and mapped glacial geomorphology datasets, producing updated gridded products of ice sheet deglaciation.

business_impact.opportunity: Estructuras de bases de datos relacionales compatibles con DuckDB y GeoParquet para almacenamiento offline de alta velocidad.

sessions.title: Bedmap Expert Group: Next-generation Antarctic Ice Thickness & Bed Topography
sessions.description: New maps and datasets of Antarctic ice thickness, bathymetry, subglacial bed topography, and grounding line datasets. Focuses on next-generation Bedmap3/Bedmap4.

business_impact.opportunity: Bedmap es el estándar mundial de geometría del lecho antártico; AMOH ya cuenta con pipeline DuckDB para alojarlo localmente y acelerar cálculos 100x.

sessions.title: Quantarctica Hands-on Workshop for Operations and Research
sessions.description: Practical hands-on training on QGIS LTR 3.44 and Quantarctica v4: accessing, visualizing, importing, and analyzing 600+ curated Antarctic geospatial datasets for research and logistics.

business_impact.opportunity: Capacitación directa del equipo para asegurar que todo el ecosistema cartográfico de AMOH sea 100% interoperable con QGIS/Quantarctica.

sessions.title: AntArchitecture: Machine Learning for 3D Radar Sounding of Ice Sheets
sessions.description: Applies Machine Learning to track internal layers and isochrones from 5 decades of radio-echo sounding radar surveys across the Antarctic continent.

business_impact.opportunity: Uso de redes neuronales convolucionales (CNN) para detección automatizada de horizontes y grietas internas en mantos de hielo.

sessions.title: Cryoseismology: A new proxy for monitoring cryosphere dynamics in the Antarctic
sessions.description: Continuous seismic, infrasound and acoustic monitoring of icequakes, glacial earthquakes, calving events, tide-modulated activity, and Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) networks.

business_impact.opportunity: Redes de sensores infrasónicos y acústicos para detectar desprendimientos de icebergs a decenas de kilómetros antes de que entren en radares ópticos.

sessions.title: QIceRadar Workshop: Open Access Polar Ice-Penetrating Radar Data in QGIS
sessions.description: Introduction to QIceRadar QGIS plugin: locates openly available ice-penetrating radar lines, downloads radargrams, and visualizes echograms alongside other geological datasets.

business_impact.opportunity: Integración del visor de radargramas de QIceRadar para permitir a los usuarios de AMOH inspeccionar perfiles transversales del hielo.

sessions.title: CCAMLR Subarea 48 Krill Biomass Acoustic Assessment & Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Catch Quotas
sessions.description: Evaluates acoustic multi-frequency survey data across the Scotia Sea and Antarctic Peninsula (Subareas 48.1, 48.2, 48.3) estimating over 60 million tonnes of regional krill biomass. Formulates dynamic spatio-temporal catch limits to prevent localized depletion around land-based predator foraging colonies (Adélie, Chinstrap, Gentoo penguins, and Antarctic fur seals).

business_impact.opportunity: Servicios de telemetría acústica y software de cuotas dinámicas en tiempo real para buques factoría krilleros (Aker BioMarine, Rimfrost) para optimizar días de pesca y certificar cumplimiento CCAMLR/MSC sin penalizaciones.

sessions.title: Antarctic & Patagonian Toothfish (Dissostichus spp.) Stock Assessment, Tag-Recapture & Cetacean Depredation Mitigation
sessions.description: Long-term PIT and satellite tagging programs assessing demersal toothfish populations at depths of 500m to 2500m in the Ross Sea (Subarea 88.1/88.2) and Heard/Macquarie Islands. Evaluates killer whale and sperm whale depredation on longlines, sea-bed bottom topography mapping, and hook-selectivity to eliminate seabird (albatross/petrel) bycatch.

business_impact.opportunity: Venta y alquiler de dispositivos acústicos no lesivos de disuasión de cetáceos y boyas inteligentes de fondo para flotas pesqueras de alta gama (Chile, Argentina, Noruega, NZ).

sessions.title: SOOS Under-Ice Biogeochemical Argo Float Fleet: Autonomous High-Latitude Profiling & Optical Sea-Ice Avoidance
sessions.description: Deployment of over 200 autonomous Biogeochemical (BGC) Argo profiling floats across the Antarctic Circumpolar Current (ACC) and seasonal sea ice zone. Equipped with optical ice detection sensors (temperature below freezing threshold & optical backscatter spikes) to abort surfacing and store CTD, pH, dissolved oxygen, and nitrate profiles internally until open-water leads appear.

business_impact.opportunity: Suministro de algoritmos de navegación acústica submarina y fabricación de boyas perfiladoras de alta presión resistentes a congelamiento para institutos oceanográficos y programas nacionales antárticos.

sessions.title: MEOP (Marine Mammals Exploring the Oceans Pole to Pole): Animal-Borne CTD Oceanographic Telemetry in Polar Winters
sessions.description: Miniaturized Conductivity-Temperature-Depth Satellite Relay Data Loggers (CTD-SRDL) glued to the fur of southern elephant seals (Mirounga leonina) and Weddell seals (Leptonychotes weddellii). Generates over 500,000 deep ocean hydrographic profiles down to 2,000m during the harsh polar winter under pack ice where research vessels cannot penetrate.

business_impact.opportunity: Integración de datos oceanográficos en tiempo casi real derivados de mamíferos marinos para asimilación en modelos numéricos de pronóstico de corrientes y temperatura del agua para rutas marítimas invernales.

sessions.title: IBCSO v2 & GEBCO Seabed 2030: Southern Ocean High-Resolution Multibeam Bathymetric Compilation
sessions.description: Comprehensive bathymetric model covering 50 million km² of the seabed south of 50°S with a 500m grid cell resolution. Incorporates 4.2 billion acoustic multibeam soundings from over 90 research icebreakers, fishing vessels, and tourist cruise liners to chart submarine canyons, deep trenches, and uncharted shallow volcanic pinnacles.

business_impact.opportunity: Licenciamiento de cartas electrónicas de navegación batimétrica de alta precisión y software de prevención de encallamiento para buques de expedición turística y naves de apoyo logístico antártico.

sessions.title: SCAR Bedmap3 & BedMachine Antarctica: Subglacial Bedrock Topography & Ice Shelf Cavity Topography
sessions.description: Next-generation 3D continental compilation of Antarctic ice thickness, surface elevation, subglacial bedrock topography, and bathymetry beneath floating ice shelves (Thwaites, Pine Island, Ronne-Filchner, Ross). Identifies retrograde slopes driving Marine Ice Sheet Instability (MISI) and calculates the exact volume of ice above floatation (equivalent to 58 meters of global sea-level rise).

business_impact.opportunity: Gemelos digitales para aseguradoras marítimas e infraestructura portuaria global para proyectar riesgos de inundación por subida del nivel del mar y desprendimiento de megabergs.

sessions.title: ASPeCt & Sentinel-1/CryoSat-2 High-Resolution SAR Sea Ice Classification & Fast-Ice Stability Forecasting
sessions.description: Machine learning pipeline trained on dual-polarization Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery to classify Antarctic sea ice into deformed pack ice, smooth first-year ice, multi-year ice, and coastal landfast ice (fast ice). Tracks leads, ridges, and open polynyas with 10-meter resolution regardless of polar night darkness or persistent cloud cover.

business_impact.opportunity: Integración de servicio comercial de rutas asistidas por radar satelital que reduce el tiempo de tránsito en campos de hielo en un 35% y ahorra miles de toneladas de combustible marino.

sessions.title: Antarctic Marine Psychrophiles: Cold-Active Enzymes & Antifreeze Glycoproteins (AFGPs) Industrial Bioprospecting
sessions.description: Genomic and structural characterization of psychrophilic bacteria (Pseudoalteromonas, Psychrobacter) and cold-adapted yeasts inhabiting sub-zero polar brine channels. Isolates cold-active proteases, lipases, amylases, and cellobiose hydrolases with high catalytic efficiency at 0°C–15°C, as well as thermal hysteresis antifreeze glycoproteins (AFGPs) from notothenioid fish serum.

business_impact.opportunity: Patentes biotecnológicas para detergentes de lavado en agua fría (ahorro energético del 75%), preservación criogénica de órganos para trasplantes sin formación de cristales de hielo, y bioplásticos biodegradables en frío.

sessions.title: COMNAP Intercontinental Air Network: Blue-Ice Runway Friction Diagnostics, Satellite Runway Monitoring & MedEvac Hubs
sessions.description: Standardized operational protocols for intercontinental wheeled aircraft operations on blue-ice runways (Troll Airfield, Wilkins Runway, Union Glacier, Novo Airfield). Utilizes satellite SAR and thermal infrared sensors to monitor surface ablation, sublimating crevasses, and braking friction coefficients for commercial and military transport aircraft (Airbus A340, Boeing 787, C-17 Globemaster III).

business_impact.opportunity: Servicios de consultoría y monitoreo satelital continuo de pistas de hielo para operadores de vuelos chárter VIP de expedición turística y transporte aéreo especializado de carga científica.

sessions.title: IMO Polar Code Tier III: Methanol & Hydrogen Hybrid Fuel Cell Propulsion for Antarctic Ice-Class Expedition Vessels
sessions.description: Engineering standards and sea trials for low- and zero-carbon propulsion systems under extreme Antarctic operating conditions (-30°C air, -1.8°C sea). Validates PEM fuel cells running on green hydrogen, e-methanol dual-fuel engines, and peak-shaving battery energy storage systems (BESS) conforming to the heavy fuel oil (HFO) carriage ban in the Antarctic Treaty Area.

business_impact.opportunity: Asesoría técnica e instalación de microrredes híbridas marinas y sistemas de captura/certificación de créditos de carbono para armadores de cruceros de expedición polar con acceso prioritario a zonas protegidas.

sessions.title: Ross Sea Region Marine Protected Area (RSRMPA): Multi-Year Ecological Monitoring, RegTech & Satellite AIS Surveillance
sessions.description: Scientific monitoring of the world's largest marine protected area (1.55 million km²). Combines synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite surveillance, optical vessel identification, and underwater passive acoustic hydrophone arrays to monitor benthic biodiversity, toothfish nursery zones, and detect potential illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) incursions.

business_impact.opportunity: Plataforma de monitoreo y verificación de cumplimiento regulatorio (RegTech) para buques que transitan aguas protegidas, garantizando trazabilidad total para exportadores pesqueros certificados.

sessions.title: IAATO Expedition Operations RegTech: Dynamic Landing Site Reservation, Biosecurity Auditing & Citizen Science Monetization
sessions.description: Algorithmic scheduling and real-time vessel traffic management for over 50 tourist landing sites across the Antarctic Peninsula (Neko Harbour, Port Lockroy, Half Moon Island). Implements automated biosecurity audit checklists, boot-washing verification, wildlife standoff compliance, and integrated onboard guest citizen-science data pipelines (Happywhale, FjordPhyto).

business_impact.opportunity: SaaS B2B para armadores y operadores de cruceros polares que automatiza la reserva de cupos de desembarco, previene colisiones de itinerarios y monetiza programas de ciencia ciudadana con los pasajeros.
